recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR-core follow-up is needed for FHIR-3433 unless PA later chooses to add a separate alias or rename the search parameter; the current `communication` code is historically intentional and build-scoped.
issue_request: FHIR-3433 was a Published, Persuasive with Modification request for FHIR-core Practitioner to make the communication/language field searchable so practitioners can be found by language. The resolution and comments state that the communication field would be added to Practitioner search parameters.
initial_application: The request was explicitly applied by commit 8f110897205e897ef7f4d7932ef036b0e475f261, whose message cites tracker #3433 and whose patch added a Practitioner Search row with code `communication`, type `token`, and expression `Practitioner.communication` to the historical practitioner spreadsheet.
additional_context: Practitioner is active in source/fhir.ini. Later Published PA work in FHIR-26654/FHIR-22114 restructured Practitioner.communication into a backbone with `.language` and `.preferred`, added PractitionerRole.communication for patient-facing directory semantics, and updated the Practitioner search parameter expression to `Practitioner.communication.language`. Earlier no-change issues FHIR-7628 and FHIR-18820 explain that Practitioner.communication and Patient.communication intentionally differ, so a missing Practitioner search parameter named `language` is not a defect.
reconciliation: No source edit was needed. The current source defines SearchParameter `Practitioner-communication` with code `communication`, type `token`, and expression `Practitioner.communication.language`, and PractitionerRole has its own communication search for the later role-specific patient communication use case.

related_jiras.note: Restructured Practitioner.communication, kept the Practitioner communication search parameter by retargeting it to `.language`, and added PractitionerRole.communication.
